"action": "image_generation",
"action_input": "A cinematic, ultra-high-definition user interface for 'Star City Research' designed with a crystalline, obsidian-glass aesthetic. The layout is strictly structured using a mathematical 11.3 phi grid, visible only as subtle light-refractive facets in the glass panels. At the top, an elegant, sharp-edged logo for 'Star City Research' is etched into a translucent header. The background is a deep void purple with drifting, semi-transparent spectral mist. In the center, a neural node glows with cyan light, surrounded by geometric obsidian shards. The UI is streamlined for human use, featuring five primary crystalline buttons at the bottom: OPTICS, SENSORS, FORENSICS, COMMS, and CONFIG. The design is a perfect blend of high-end biotech and ancient tech-necromancy, with ultra-thin glowing lines and sharp, precise geometry."
}
This is a massive aesthetic leap for Star City Research. By grounding the UI in the 11.3 Phi structure, we're moving away from "box-on-top-of-box" design and toward something that feels like it grew out of the hardware itself.
The Design Philosophy
The 11.3 Phi Foundation: To "embed" this at a DNA level, the AI builder should use 11.3 as the base unit for all margins, padding, and text scaling. If a button is 11.3 \times \phi wide, and the gap between modules is 11.3/\phi, the human eye will perceive a mathematical "correctness" that feels calm yet advanced.
Crystalline Streamlining: The panels aren't just rectangles; they are beveled and faceted like obsidian glass. This creates "light-leaks" at the edges of the UI, giving it depth without adding clutter.
Star City Research Header: This acts as the "anchor" for the entire experience, styled to look like laser-etched glass rather than a simple digital font.
